findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

evidence.snippet: fetch

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "security_headers" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: HTTP security headers audit of a website with a grade. Fetches the page and grades its security headers A to F: HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, clickjacking prot…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "world_geocode" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search places by name or address via Nominatim. Forward geocoding: returns up to 5 matches with coordinates, type, category, importance, address components and …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
